targeted_scenarios.title: Exact selection across five spells
targeted_scenarios.result: Brainstorm: Abrade selected with exact requested top/bottom choices; Ponder: Abrade selected with exact requested top/bottom choices; Preordain: Abrade selected with exact requested top/bottom choices; Telling Time: Abrade selected with exact requested top/bottom choices; Impulse: Abrade selected with exact requested top/bottom choices. Brainstorm/Ponder/Preordain draw; Telling Time/Impulse put a looked-at card into hand.

targeted_scenarios.title: Prowess, trigger doubling and Wizard adaptation
targeted_scenarios.result: Ponder gave Harmonic exactly +1/+1, doubled Pyromancer to 2 Elementals, and created 1 Iconoclast Soldier. After Adaptation resolved, Preordain doubled Iconoclast too. Totals: 4 Elementals, 4 Soldiers. Harmonic reached 4/6 after three noncreature casts, then returned to 1/3 in cleanup.

targeted_scenarios.title: Artifact power tracks tokens entering and being spent
targeted_scenarios.result: Artist was 4 power with Sol Ring plus an artifact Soldier. Ponder added 2 Treasures and another Soldier, raising it to 7. Activating an actual Treasure for U immediately lowered power to 6. That mana paid for Preordain; its triggers added 3 artifacts, raising power to 9.

targeted_scenarios.title: Baral loot is successful-counter-only and independently optional
targeted_scenarios.result: An actual Counterspell countered the control seat's creature spell. Harmonic doubled Baral into two separate loot triggers. The first was accepted (draw then discard); the second was declined. Counterspell's colored UU requirement was preserved despite Baral.

targeted_scenarios.title: Copies trigger again and delayed exile is not doubled
targeted_scenarios.result: With Harmonic, the first spell produced 2 Stormsplitter tokens. The second produced 6 more: 9 Stormsplitters including the original. At the next end-step beginning, exactly 8 delayed exile abilities queued (not doubled). Tokens survived until those abilities resolved, then all 8 ceased; the original remained.

targeted_scenarios.title: A copy made during an end step waits through cleanup
targeted_scenarios.result: Brainstorm was cast with actual source mana during end-step priority. Its Stormsplitter token was created after that step began. It survived cleanup, then its delayed exile triggered and resolved at the following player's end step.

targeted_scenarios.title: Queued copies survive a source bounce without copying pumps
targeted_scenarios.result: Ponder queued a copy trigger. Capsize responded, queuing another before bouncing the pumped original Stormsplitter. Both copy triggers resolved: the older one used last-known copiable values. Both tokens were base 1/4, not the modified original's 4/7; the actual original card returned to hand.

caveat: One real detailed deck plus synthetic opponents; no win-rate inference. Safety stops, if any, remain unresolved games.
